items.html: 6, veRav Chesed (and abounding in mercy); 7, veEmet (and truth); 8, Notzer Chesed (keeping mercy); 9, LaAlafim (for thousands). For it could have been "Notzer Chesed" alone, but its being also "for thousands of generations" is another correction, in the manner of what was said about Erech Apayim. 10, Nosei Avon (pardoning iniquity); 11, vaPesha (and transgression); 12, veChata'ah (and sin); 13, veNakeh (and cleansing). Behold, these thirteen corrections are in the face of AA up to the throat, for from there onward is the Bina of AA, but these thirteen are from the Hochma of AA.
